author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: N-sight RMM has no syslog, webhook or audit log export, and its Data Extraction API has no technician activity log. collectors/n-able-n-sight-failing-checks polls list_failing_checks and posts a JSON record when a check starts failing or clears; each goes to the third-party alert schema with the device, the check description and output, client and site. Security-relevant checks (antivirus, event log, Windows service, backup) show up this way; logins, remote sessions and script runs don't, because N-sight doesn't expose them. The record keys are the collector's, holding the fields of N-able's documented XML; N-sight gives no severity, and the event time is when the collector saw the change. Check types, descriptions and outputs in the samples are made up. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (52 of 52 fields matched the emulator). No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
